story_title: Natural Disasters: A Century of Human Impact
story_subtitle: Analyzing Death Toll Trends Across Droughts, Earthquakes, Epidemics, and Other Disasters from 1900 to 2017

story_pieces.narration: The year 1917 recorded the highest global natural disaster deaths at 2,523,507, primarily due to drought and extreme weather events. This spike dwarfs all other years in the dataset.
story_pieces.question: Which year had the highest death toll from natural disasters, and what factors contributed to this extreme figure?
story_pieces.visualization: bar chart (years vs. total deaths) with outlier highlighting

story_pieces.narration: Droughts accounted for 45% of all natural disaster deaths in the 20th century, with the 1928 drought (3 million deaths) being the single deadliest event in the dataset.
story_pieces.question: How do drought-related deaths compare to other disaster types over the 20th century?
story_pieces.visualization: stacked bar chart (decades vs. deaths by disaster type)

story_pieces.narration: The 1976 Tangshan earthquake in China (276,994 deaths) and the 1918 influenza pandemic (449,700 deaths) were the two most deadly events in the dataset, showcasing the dual threat of geological and biological disasters.
story_pieces.question: Which specific disasters had the highest death tolls, and how do their impacts compare?
story_pieces.visualization: bar chart (events vs. deaths) with side-by-side comparison

story_pieces.narration: Epidemics showed a dramatic decline in mortality rates from the 1910s to 2010s, with the 1918 pandemic (449,700 deaths) being the deadliest, while modern epidemics like Ebola (2014-2016) had significantly lower death tolls.
story_pieces.question: How has the mortality rate from epidemics changed over the 20th and 21st centuries?
story_pieces.visualization: line chart (years vs. deaths) with trendline

story_pieces.narration: Extreme weather events saw a marked increase in mortality from the 1990s onwards, with the 2010 floods (835,600 deaths) and 2017 hurricanes (1,300+ deaths) representing modern climate-related risks.
story_pieces.question: Has the impact of extreme weather events on human mortality increased in recent decades?
story_pieces.visualization: scatter plot (years vs. deaths) with trendline and clustering
